0022600023.text: The Warriors (2-3, 10th in the West and 2nd in the Pacific, 2 games back) are hosting the Lakers (4-1, 1st in the Pacific, 3rd in the West) in Golden State's sixth game of the season, an Emirates NBA Cup West Group C matchup, with the Warriors on a two-game win streak and the Lakers coming off a win. Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), while Los Angeles is missing Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Ziaire Williams (foot). The Warriors trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after losing 127-105 in Los Angeles on October 21, and they lost the 2025-26 series 1-3.
